programmes.show_description: Jacqui and Andrews' big gold dreams are stalled by communication issues. And, the Poseidon Crew battle wet weather to unearth a monster pay day. S8, Ep6
Arachnid Overload. A survival-savvy yoga teacher and a knife maker tackle the brutal jungle of Colombia. Deadly spiders and tics test their nerve and resilience - will it break them? S2, Ep21
King of the Forest. A self-proclaimed 'king of the forest' and an endurance athlete endure the Alabama backwoods. Battling extreme hunger, they take gruesomely desperate measures. S2, Ep22

Christiansburg House. The team travels to Christiansburg to salvage an old home and get some mantels and banisters. Plus, Mike and Tay build a couch that can fit a Whiteside. S7, Ep11
Park-N-Shop Grocery Store. The Black Dog Salvage crew heads to Mike's hometown of Charlotte, North Carolina, to check out the signage they can save from his very first job. S7, Ep12
Gold Blooded. Captain Vernon is on the final leg of his epic journey transporting the Gold Ship Wild Ranger to Nome. Plus, Emily faces ripping currents and an exhausted diver. S8, Ep7
Missing In Action. When a fellow miner vanishes, Ken and Shawn interrupt their operations to join the search and rescue. Plus, Vern finally unleashes on the Bering Sea. S8, Ep8
Marcus and Linden suffer an injury that could end their road trip. The Dust Devils attempt to produce the biggest gold pour of the season so far. S5, Ep14
Curse Of The Kraken. Jeremy Wade reveals the new deep-sea discoveries that might prove the existence of the infamous giant squid. Is this underwater monster the legendary kraken? S1, Ep3
Goodbye Jake. King Crab season comes to an end and the fleet pull up their last pots. Young captain Jake Anderson struggles with the decision to leave the Northwestern. S9, Ep7
Kicking Off with a Bang. The Time Bandit crew races back to the dock after a freak accident. Will they be able to reap the rewards of the rich opilio season? S9, Ep8
Hunt For The Gold Table. After discovering a 1700s-era cannon Darrell seeks the ship's origin. A letter in Gordon's files details a 16th century wreck connected to Sir Francis Drake. S2, Ep2
World's 8th Wonder. Josh journeys from Russia to Germany in search of history's most expensive stolen object, the Amber Chamber. He retraces the steps of Nazi soldiers. S1, Ep3
Amelia Earhart. Josh Gates hunts down new evidence on the disappearance of Amelia Earhart. He starts in Papua New Guinea, ending his journey in Fiji, hoping to find her remains. S1, Ep4
Black Hills Hope. The Raneys struggle to revive a Wyoming homestead with a tragic legacy. To bring water to the property, Marty must solve the mystery of an untapped well. S5, Ep1
One Plus One Equals Three. Rod, Sam and Ben use their last dig of the season to secure enough opal for Les' retirement. Cody almost meets his demise down a 10-metre mine shaft. S7, Ep20
Rookie Mistakes. With Dan stuck at home, Justin starts the new mining season alone. He is dealt a huge blow when their rich underground mine has been pegged by another miner. S2, Ep1
Storm Surge. Captains take on the steepest waves yet in an epic final surge to hit their quotas. Jake deals with a crew injury on deck and engine failure causes trouble for Sig. S14, Ep20
Battle Of Kings Part 1. Hours before king season, a huge new boat with a renegade captain finds the crab are all in one spot. The fleet races to find the hoard. S15, Ep1
Mouse-Free Retreat. The crew head to Maine to rescue a DIY project. With a new addition and a mouse issue to fix, can the team finish before the owners' 10th anniversary? S15, Ep9
Hilltop Hybrid. The team head to the hills of Pocahontas County, West Virginia to try something new. They create a hybrid timber frame structure. S15, Ep9
An armed trespasser threatens the Gold Devils' exploration mission. Plus, the Ferals uncover the biggest gold nugget of their mining careers. S8, Ep7
From the Ashes. A biology student and an expert survival instructor team up on the swampy shore of Croatia, but their strong partnership is tested by a freak accident. S2, Ep23
Stone Cold. An Army vet and a newly married man grapple with gender norms as they hit the mountains of Croatia. They must bond closely as a vicious storm threatens to rip them apart. S2, Ep24

Burlington Wall Unit. The teams visit Burlington to save an old apothecary unit from a 1930s pharmacy. Mike and Robert search for some new patterns for the shop in West Virginia. S7, Ep13
Former United Methodist Church. The team head to Delaware, to salvage what they can from a former church that fell victim to water damage. The crew removes pews and a skylight. S8, Ep1
Battle Plan. In the waning days of a gruelling summer mining season, everyone is desperate to find as much as possible. Plus, dangerous winds threaten Shawn's installation. S8, Ep9
Pay The Piper. Mining the Bering Sea is a difficult and dangerous job. The miners provide new insight as they discuss their toughest and richest season yet. S8, Ep2
The Poseidon Crew finally get permission to dig for gold in century-old mine shafts. And, the Gold Timers take a gamble on a new lease. S5, Ep15
The Bermuda Triangle Conspiracy. Jeremy Wade investigates if one of the Bermuda Triangle's most infamous disappearances was part of a conspiracy by a secret agent at war with the US. S1, Ep4
The Storm Of The Season. A serious storm strikes the fleet only weeks into the season. As the captains celebrate their first pots, can they all stay afloat and keep their catch? S9, Ep9
Sleeping with the Enemy. As the fleet battles through an arctic storm, Junior risks everything to get back in the game, and the greenhorns struggle to keep up with their crews. S9, Ep10
Wreck In The Shallows. Darrell heads to a shipwreck linked to Gordo's list. He leads his team to the shallows where the tough winds and waves have claimed centuries worth of ships. S2, Ep3
City Of Gold. Josh treks the Inca Trail through the Andes and into the Peruvian Amazon in search of a mythical city of gold. His journey takes a detour to the ruins of Machu Picchu. S1, Ep5
Captain Morgan's Lost Gold. Josh dives into the Lajas Reef in search of the treasure of legendary pirate Henry Morgan. His journey takes him to a modern marvel, the Panama Canal. S1, Ep6
By A Landslide. The Raneys meet their match on a homestead in Idaho, where millennial off-gridders are plagued with dead soil, grizzly bear visits and constant landslides. S5, Ep2
Wild Wild West. Justin's excavator has an expensive oil leak. Plus, Col's crew are a man down and the Fire Crew are on a wild goose chase hunting a bounty of fabled fire opal. S2, Ep2
Going Under. For the Rookies, there's tension as a new partner leads them on a wild goose chase underground. Plus, the Cooke Brothers' season is off to a bad and dangerous start. S2, Ep3
Battle Of Kings Part 2. Hours before king season, a huge new boat with a renegade captain finds the crab are all in one spot. The fleet races to find the hoard. S15, Ep2
Swarm Chasers. An old rivalry heats up between Harley and Keith while the fleet chases the king crab super swarm. Rookie captain Mandy hopes to guide the Northwestern to success. S15, Ep2
The Van Meter Monster. Horrified locals in Iowa are reporting sightings of a giant winged creature - the same mysterious beast that terrorized the town of Van Meter 100 years ago. S3, Ep2
Viking Secrets. Josh Gates investigates how a group of Norse tribesmen gained power in medieval Europe. His quest for answers takes him from Denmark to Iceland. S4, Ep5
